# `input_file_block_start`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the start offset of the block being read, or -1 if not available.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
input_file_block_start()
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `misc_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 0 |
| Deterministic | no |

## Examples

```sql
-- input_file_block_start, example 1
> SELECT input_file_block_start();
-1
```
